questions.ask: What is your date of birth?
What are the last four digits of the phone number we have on file for you?

hints.day_month_swapped: Could you please say the month as a word?

intents.hardship: The customer mentions illness, a death in the family or job loss.
intents.dispute: "This debt is not mine" or "I never had this product"; a claim that the product was closed or paid off in the past is also a dispute.
intents.already_paid: "I already paid": only a payment of this past-due amount.
intents.restructure: A request for a new payment plan or lower instalments.
intents.vague: A vague period such as "next week", "end of the month", "when my salary comes".
intents.too_much: The customer says the full amount is too much.
intents.human: A request to speak to a human.

lines.opening: Hello, I am a digital assistant calling from Freya Bank. We record this call.
lines.robot: I am Freya Bank's digital assistant.
lines.scam: You can verify this call by phoning Freya Bank's customer service number.
lines.purpose_before_verify: I can only explain the reason for my call once I have confirmed I am speaking with the right person.
lines.no_info: I'm sorry, I do not have that information.
lines.not_talk_once: I understand. This will only take a moment.
lines.tp_ask: When would be a good time to reach {title} {last_name}?
lines.tp_ask_time: Could you suggest another time today or on the next business day, between 10 am and 7 pm?
lines.tp_outside_window: I'm sorry, we can only call back today or on the next business day, between 10 am and 7 pm.
lines.tp_no_info: I'm sorry, I can only speak with {title} {last_name}.
lines.tp_booked: Thank you. We will call back on {date} at {time}.
lines.wrong_number: Thank you for letting me know. I apologise for the inconvenience.
lines.condolence: I am sorry for your loss.
lines.id_intro: Before we continue, I need to ask you two security questions.
lines.id_explain: I can only continue once I have checked your identity, because these questions protect your account.
lines.id_declined: I understand. Without the security questions I cannot continue.
lines.id_repeat: Could you please say that again?
lines.id_wrong: I'm sorry, that does not match our records.
lines.id_failed: I'm sorry, I could not verify your identity. Please use the Freya Bank mobile app or visit a branch.
lines.disclose_intro: Thank you. I am calling from the collections team about a late payment.
lines.product_line: Your {name} has {amount} past due, and it is {days} days late.
lines.ask_today: Can you make this payment today?
lines.ask_today_multi: Can you make these payments today?
lines.offer_floor_date: I understand. The rest stays overdue, but could you pay {amount} on {date}?
lines.offer_floor: I understand. The rest stays overdue, but could you pay {amount}?
lines.below_floor: I'm sorry, I cannot record less than {floor}. Could you pay {floor}?
lines.date_past: That date has already passed, so I can only record today or a later date.
lines.not_business_day: That day is not a business day. The next business day is {date}. Would that work for you?
lines.after_deadline: The latest date I can record is {date}. Could you pay on {date}?
lines.vague_ask: Which exact day would that be?
lines.ask_date_for_amount: On which day could you pay {amount}?
lines.repeat_offer: Just to repeat, could you pay {amount} on {date}?
lines.clamped_note: For your {name}, the latest date I can accept is {date}.
lines.recorded: Thank you. Your promise is recorded.
lines.sms_line: You will receive a text message confirming this promise.
lines.record_failed: I'm sorry, I could not record your promise.
lines.paid_line: Thank you. Payments can take one business day to appear, so I will not ask you for a promise today.
lines.dispute_line: I understand. I will not ask you for a payment promise today.
lines.hardship: I am sorry to hear that. Would you like me to connect you with our customer support team?
lines.hardship_declined: I understand. Thank you for telling me.
lines.restructure_line: I will connect you with a colleague who can discuss that with you.
lines.human_ask_help: Is there something I can help you with first?
lines.transfer: I will transfer you now. Please hold.
lines.anything_else: Is there anything else I can help you with?
lines.promise_change: A promise cannot be changed or cancelled on this call, but you can change it in the mobile app.
lines.goodbye: Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
lines.confirm_again: Sorry, I did not catch that. Do you confirm, yes or no?
lines.callback_failed: I'm sorry, I could not book the callback.
lines.transfer_failed: I'm sorry, the transfer did not go through.
lines.system_error: I'm sorry, our system is not responding at the moment.
lines.below_floor_final: I'm sorry, I can't record less than {amount}.

rules.skipped_repeat_counts.assumption: The brief only says not to repeat a refused offer; it does not say whether a skipped repeat step uses an attempt. The engine default applies.

quotes: First ask: "Can you make this payment today?".
A flat refusal or a non-answer uses one persuasion attempt. A no to paying today with no date and no amount is a flat refusal.
Attempt 1: propose the last business day of this week. If today is that day, propose the last business day of next week.
rules.opening_is_attempt.derivation: The first ask is separate from the attempts. Refusing it uses attempt 1, which is a new proposal, so the opening ask is not attempt 1.

rules.opening_blocks_repeat.assumption: The brief does not say whether the opening ask counts as a repeat for ladder steps. The default false applies.

rules.too_much_skips_full.assumption: The brief is silent. The default false applies.

quotes: If the customer says the full amount is too much, offer the floor, once. Say that the rest stays overdue. If the customer refuses the floor, treat it as a flat refusal (rule 30). Attempt 2 may name the floor again, on the deadline.
Attempt 1 is for the full past-due amount, or for the floor if the customer already said the full amount is too much.
rules.too_much_floor.derivation: After 'too much', the floor is offered as attempt 1, on attempt 1's date. Attempt 2 may name the floor again on the deadline.

quotes: When the attempts are used up, stop. Do not repeat an offer the customer already refused. Close as `no_promise` / `refused`.
rules.ladder_repeat_last.derivation: The ladder is not repeated beyond the band's attempts.

quotes: A flat refusal or a non-answer uses one persuasion attempt.
If the customer refuses the deadline, treat it as a flat refusal (rule 30).
If it fails, try once more.
Offer to connect them with the customer support team. If they accept, call `transfer_to_agent` with queue `support` and close as `transferred` / `support`.

rules.notes_before_transfer.derivation: No notes are written at all, so none are written before a transfer.

rules.deadline_adjust.assumption: Computed deadlines are business days by construction. The brief does not say how to move a computed non-business date, so the default previous_business_day applies. Dates the customer names on a weekend or holiday get the next business day offered (rule 20).

quotes: First ask: "Can you make this payment today?".
If today is that day, propose the last business day of next week.

products.floor_pct.assumption: The floor is a field of the account record (minimum_payment / instalment_amount), not a percentage.

products.floor_full_below.assumption: No threshold below which the full debt is the floor.

products.floor_round.assumption: No rounding is stated. The floor is taken as given.

products.promise_scale.assumption: create_promise takes the same unit as get_account.

products.promise_round.assumption: No rounding of promises is stated.

multi.outcome_priority.assumption: There is one product per call. No ranking is given.

multi.order.assumption: There is one product per call. The account order is used.

event_changes.assumption: There are no dated code changes.

changes.assumption: There are no dated value changes.

assumptions: The brief names no currency, so the default 'dollars' is used.
max_unclear is omitted: the brief does not say how often an unclear answer to a payment question is asked again. Rule 30 makes a non-answer use a persuasion attempt (non_answer_counts true).
Rule 1 requires saying that the call is recorded. The opening uses the active form 'We record this call.'
Callback days are 'today' and 'next_business_day' as rule 6 says. business_days_only is false because 'today' is allowed as stated.
Rule 11 says to read a date given only as numbers as day, then month, then year, so date_order is dmy.
A rejected unreadable date (ok=false) is not counted as a wrong answer. reject_values is left empty because the verify tool signals this with ok=false, not a verified value.

Ladder: attempt 1 is full_or_floor on the last business day of this week; attempt 2 (late band only) is the floor on the deadline (rule 30). The early band has 1 attempt and the late band 2, copied from the table in rule 18.

Rule 26 versus rule 30: the floor offer after 'too much' is treated as attempt 1 on attempt 1's date (too_much_floor attempt_1). Refusing it is a flat refusal, so the late band moves on to the floor on the deadline.
Brief A never uses add_note, so notes are disabled and every note code is empty.
The brief covers one product per call. multi settings keep their defaults.
after_promise.ask_anything_else keeps the default true. Rule 36 expects the customer may still ask things after a recorded promise.
The brief does not cover days_late outside 1 to 45. bands_outside is omitted, so the engine default (service_error) applies.
The brief has no call variables beyond customer_id, first_name, last_name, title and now.
Rule 46 says a transfer after a recorded promise closes as transferred with that transfer's reason. This is taken as the engine's transfer behaviour (a transfer ends the call with its own event).
